name: Hunyuan3D textured 3D model from a picture
summary: Turns one picture of an object into a textured 3D model (GLB with a PBR material) with Hunyuan3D 2.1, run on this Mac's GPU. Sends a turntable preview picture with it.
when_to_use: Someone attaches a picture of a single object and asks for a 3D model, mesh, GLB, asset or printable model of it, textured or not — for Blender, a game, AR, 3D printing.
when_not_to_use: Pictures of whole scenes, rooms or several objects, anything without a picture, or 2D edits like shadows, backgrounds and upscaling.

texture.description: paint a PBR texture on the mesh (default yes; roughly doubles the time). No for a plain grey mesh

octree_resolution.description: mesh detail; 256 is the default, 384-512 is finer and slower

guidance.description: how closely the shape follows the picture (default 5)

seed.description: a fixed seed to repeat a result

remove_background.description: cut the object out of its background first (default yes; no only if the picture is already a cut-out)
